title: TheReal
description: Complete modpack of the Real universe.
body:
# I hope you have at least a little fun with this Modpack :)

Modpack made based on **SimplyOptimized** with the intention of being Optimized and Extraordinary, keeping a bit of Vanilla and a few extra things.

This Modpack offers great open-world immersion and exploration with insane new Structures, Naturalist and Wildlife Animals, along with the Distant Horizon. Mob and Player animations include Fresh Animations, as well as ambient and general sounds using Ambient Sounds and Physics Sounds mods. With beauty in mind, there are mods that make details more beautiful.

This is a Modpack is the complete experience of merging the **RealClient Modpack** and **RealServer Modpack** made for gamers together, thus maintaining a good experience for gamers without crashes or lags.


```
Minimum use of 4GB of RAM.
Recommended use of 8GB RAM or more.
```


This Modpack offers excellent immersion and exploration in the varied open world of **William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld** and **Tectonic**, ambient sounds using the **Sound Physic Remastered** mod. New structures from **Yung's** and **Dungeons and Taverns**.

Removed Herobrine.

# Have a good game!
